about: Color palettes collected from public Instagram posts by dopely.colors and dyslove.design (pulled 2026-10-26). Hex values are the ones printed on the slides; hex_from "sampled" means the label was unreadable and the value was measured from the swatch pixels. Credit the source if a palette is shared as-is.
